betPlace.title: Bet on a teammate
betPlace.subtitle: Stake dust on a teammate's pulls
betPlace.noTeammates: No teammate available: you're alone on this team.
betPlace.explanationGeneric: The odds cover the next {{pullWindow}} pulls: at least one {{rarity}} pull or better within this window wins you the bet. Your teammates can raise on your side or against you, which will move the odds until the target's first pull. The stake is refunded, on both sides, only if the target makes no pull before the deadline.
betPlace.explanationWithTarget: The odds cover the target's next {{pullWindow}} pulls: at least one {{rarity}} pull or better within this window wins you the bet. Your teammates can raise on your side or against you, which will move the odds until the target's first pull. The stake is refunded, on both sides, only if the target makes no pull before the deadline.
betPlace.submitNoWin: This bet wouldn't pay out anything
betPlace.noWinExplanation: Odds {{multiplier}}: the outcome is already (almost) certain in this window, this bet wouldn't pay out more than the stake placed.
betPlace.potentialGain: Potential payout if the bet wins: {{payout}} dust

duelPropose.title: Challenge a teammate
duelPropose.subtitle: Stake your next pulls against a teammate
duelPropose.noTeammates: No teammate available: they're all already in a duel, or you're alone on this team.
duelPropose.ruleCounts: Your next {{pullCount}} pulls count, on each side.
duelPropose.ruleScoring: The best score wins and takes the cards the other pulled. It's scored like the leaderboard: the higher the rarity, the more the card is worth, and a brilliant counts one and a half times.
duelPropose.ruleLocked: While the duel lasts, the counted cards can no longer be recycled or turned into dust.
duelPropose.ruleTie: On a tie, everyone keeps their cards. If someone lags behind, the duel settles at its deadline and the missing pulls count as zero.

duelResult.subtitle: Pull duel finished
duelResult.verdictTie: You end up tied against <opponent></opponent>. Everyone keeps their cards.
duelResult.verdictWinEmpty: You beat <opponent></opponent>, but their stake was empty: they no longer owned the cards they'd pulled.
duelResult.verdictLossEmpty: <opponent></opponent> wins, but your stake was empty: you no longer owned the cards you'd pulled.

betJoin.oddsNotFixed: These odds aren't fixed: every bet placed after yours will shift the pot split, in either direction. They can't drop below the odds computed from {{target}}'s real chances — that's a floor.
